user: DB freshness checks are now unambiguous — synced_at's clock skew and all-row rewrites are documented so nobody chases a phantom sync bug.
what: New learning documenting that synced_at runs ~4 days ahead of wall clock and every sync pass touches all rows; the right freshness signal is the embedding gap.
why: Prevents future misdiagnosis of the sync as broken or 'from the future' when checking whether the DB is up to date.
summary: Recorded learning: bookmarks.synced_at runs ~4 days ahead of wall clock (skewed sync-source clock, but monotonic), and the external Raindrop sync rewrites synced_at on every row each pass — so synced_at vs now() is useless for staleness and 'recently synced' counts can't find new bookmarks; use the embedding gap (bookmarks vs embeddings count) instead. Cross-linked to the existing mirror/sync learnings and the embed cron entity.

user: Switching to the llms tab no longer crashes the page with a 500 error
what: Clicking the llms tab used to make SvelteKit's client router receive markdown instead of data JSON, causing a JSON.parse console error and a 500 error page. Data requests now always bypass the llms-view negotiation and return proper JSON, while direct /?view=llm fetches still get raw markdown.
why: The llms tab was unusable in production — any click broke the page until a full reload.
next: Try the llms tab again — it now switches cleanly between the rendered and raw views
summary: llms-view negotiation hook intercepted SvelteKit's __data.json client-router fetches (event.url normalized to route path) and returned markdown, breaking tab navigation; now early-returns on event.isDataRequest.
